description: Compare 2–5 creators side by side by their unified cross-platform CreatorScore (the WHOLE footprint, never a single platform), ranked best to worst with tier + risk count. Pass each creator by NAME or @handle — NEVER ask for a platform; each input is resolved to that creator's full footprint automatically. Cached, never scrapes. Costs 1 credit per already-scored creator; a creator with no footprint score yet shows as a gap (build it with score_creator_footprint — no charge here).

creators.description: 2–5 creators to compare, each by name or handle.

query.description: A creator's NAME (e.g. "Mel Robbins") or @handle (e.g. "@rambothepuppy") — resolved to their whole footprint. Do NOT pass a platform.
